htmlChunks:
That is awesome! Minecraft schematics are an incredible way to bring massive builds or intricate redstone designs into your game without having to build them blind. 
To help you get that schematic loaded up and visible in your world, here is a quick guide on what to do next based on the mod you are using: 
🛠️ If you are using Litematica (Highly Recommended for Survival)
Litematica projects a "ghost" holographic blueprint into your world so you can place the blocks perfectly. 
  1. Drop the file in: Place your .litematic file inside the schematics folder in your Minecraft directory. (If you are using a custom launcher like CurseForge or Modrinth, go to your instance options, open the resource pack folder, and go up one folder to find it).
  2. Load it in-game: Press M to open the main menu, click Load Schematics, select your file, and click Load.
  3. Move it around: Equip a Stick, hold Alt, and use your mouse scroll wheel to perfectly align the hologram with the ground.
  4. Gather materials: Press M + L to open the material list so you know exactly what blocks you need to gather. 
⚡ If you are using WorldEdit (Best for Creative Mode)
If you have a .schem or .schematic file and want to paste it instantly: 
  1. Put the file into your server or single-player config/worldedit/schematics folder.
  2. Type /schematic load [filename] in your in-game chat.
  3. Stand exactly where you want the build to paste and type /paste. 
What kind of schematic did you get, and what mod are you using? Let me know if you need help finding your schematics folder, generating a materials shopping list, or rotating the build!
